authority.escalation: If premium work appears necessary, stop with CONFLICT and return authorization checkpoint

bounded_objective: Produce one complete replacement Plan for implementing compact reference-based handoff and context-pressure rotation architecture (outcomes A-G). Plan must not contain placeholder blocks, truncation, or omitted markdown/python sections.

cost_control.principle: Use compact references with focused retrieval guidance. Do not expand artifacts into dispatch messages. Lead retrieves only what needed for next action.

evidence_manifest_reference.retrieval_guidance: Verify access and hash. Use focused retrieval guidance therein to access only required repository state.

mandatory_scope: Do not execute, approve, or publish work
Do not recursively dispatch another Planner
Do not inline the referenced target task or manifest into this dispatch response
Do not let Planner self-approve or modify acceptance criteria

must_include: Ordered owned STEPS with brief decision bases
plan_artifact.retrieval_guidance: Planner must Write plan artifact to disk before returning. Lead will read from disk; do not include plan bytes in conversation return.

rejection_criteria: Any placeholder blocks (e.g., 'Markdown', 'Python', ellipsis replacing content)
Incomplete plan (missing outcome, test strategy, or harness design)
Plan bytes in conversation envelope (use reference only)
Lead-authored planning or narrative in plan
Plan exceeds 65536 bytes and DECOMPOSE_REQUIRED not returned

target_task_reference.retrieval_guidance: Read entire file for complete task statement, outcomes A-G, acceptance tests, and terminal conditions

validation_requirements.step_1: Validate access to target_task and evidence_manifest files; verify both hashes immediately
validation_requirements.step_3: Ensure plan spans outcomes A (reference contract), B (dispatch ticket), C (transport recovery), D (checkpoint), E (resume), F (compact returns), G (preservation)
validation_requirements.step_4: Confirm plan includes deterministic acceptance test strategy covering 18 categories
validation_requirements.step_5: Confirm plan includes context-pressure harness design
validation_requirements.step_6: Plan must remain within 65536 bytes; return DECOMPOSE_REQUIRED if not achievable
